evidence_items.explanation: The survey describes task-dependent use of multiple models and both price and non-price switching motivations. It supports the availability of alternatives, but neither multi-model use nor this broadly dated survey establishes target-period commoditization.
A concrete feature difference limits substitution for visual workloads. It cautions against inferring interchangeability from reasoning scores, but cannot refute a claim about most text workloads.
